en.正文使用宋体风格字体: Body text uses a Song-style font
en.清空当前数据，完全恢复备份: Clear current data and fully restore the backup
en.灰色的日子还没到，不能提前记录；以前的日记随时可以补写或修改。: Gray days haven't arrived yet, so you can't record ahead of time; earlier diary entries can be written or edited at any time.
en.用「生成分享包」导出发给对方，对方导入即合并: Export it with "Create share pack" and send it over; it merges as soon as they import it
en.电子书，读取书内目录与书名作者（含压缩包）: E-book: reads the table of contents, title and author inside the file (archives included)
en.电脑上可用方向键 / WASD 操作；手机可直接在画面上滑动，或用下方按键。切到: On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD; on a phone, swipe directly on the screen or use the buttons below. It pauses automatically when you switch to another page.
en.目标只是提醒，不影响保存。达成时会自动弹一次提示。: The goal is just a reminder and doesn't affect saving. A prompt appears once when you reach it.
en.第一章：雨夜归来，发现旧信: Chapter 1: Returning on a rainy night, finding an old letter
en.第三章揭晓：有人一直在等他回来: Chapter 3 reveals: someone has been waiting for him to return
en.第二章：拆信与回忆穿插: Chapter 2: Opening the letter interwoven with memories
en.细节：伞骨滴水 → 暗示时间流逝: Detail: water dripping from the umbrella ribs → hints that time is passing
en.结局构想：他最终选择留下: Ending idea: he finally chooses to stay
en.给作品单独设密码: Set a separate password for the work
en.给分支选颜色后，节点左侧的竖条与写作页的对照面板都会显示同一种颜色。: After you pick a color for a branch, the vertical bar on the left of the node and the reference panel on the writing page show that same color.
en.给这一支上色，颜色会一路继承到子节点（可在下方关闭）。: Color this branch; the color carries down to child nodes (you can turn this off below).
en.统计与成就在顶部栏的图表按钮里。所有功能都只读写本机数据。: Statistics and achievements are in the chart button on the top bar. Every feature only reads and writes data on this device.
en.网页另存的文件，自动去掉标签只留正文: A saved web page: tags are stripped automatically and only the body text is kept
en.自动按「第X章 / # 标题」切分章节: Automatically split chapters at "Chapter X / # Heading"
en.解锁状态只在本次使用期间有效：重新打开应用后需要再输一次密码。: The unlocked state lasts only for this session: after you reopen the app, you need to enter the password again.
en.设置密码（数字或字母都行）: Set a password (digits or letters both work)
en.读书笔记：怎样做笔记: Reading notes: how to take notes
en.输入关键词开始搜索 · 全部在本地完成: Type a keyword to search · all done locally
en.还没有作品加入协作。打开一部小说 / 文章 / 日记本，在「更多」菜单里选「加入: No works have joined the collaboration yet. Open a novel / article / diary and choose "Join collaboration" from the "More" menu.
en.还没有便签。写正文时想到什么，就记在这里 —— 不会混进正文。: No notes yet. Whenever something comes to mind while writing, jot it here — it won't get mixed into the body text.
en.还没有加入协作室: You haven't joined a collaboration room yet
en.还没有音符 —— 到上面点几个格子，这里就会出现乐谱。: No notes yet — tap a few cells above and the score will appear here.
en.这一天再写一篇: Write another entry for this day
en.这些字体都是系统自带的免费字体，不联网、不占额外空间；缺失时自动回退，不会出现方: These fonts are all free fonts that come with the system; they need no network and take up no extra space, and the app falls back automatically if one is missing, so you never see empty boxes.
en.这是「起头器」，不是 AI 代写: This is a "starter", not AI ghostwriting
en.这里想表达什么、卡在哪、下一步写什么……（Ctrl+Enter 保存）: What you want to say here, where you're stuck, what to write next… (Ctrl+Enter to save)
en.连续百日: A hundred days in a row
en.选一部作品，导出成一个文件发给朋友；对方导入时自动合并且不会覆盖各自的内容。: Pick a work and export it as one file to send to a friend; when they import it, it merges automatically and neither side's content is overwritten.
en.选不到文件？也可以用「粘贴文本」把内容直接贴进来。导入的内容默认不计入成就与统计: Can't find the file? You can also use "Paste text" to paste the content in directly. Imported content doesn't count toward achievements or statistics by default.
en.随手机深浅色自动切换: Follows the phone's light and dark mode automatically
en.颜色越深记录越多: The darker the color, the more entries
en.默认，适合长篇阅读与正式文稿: Default, suited to long reads and formal documents
